text: The default numerical admission source now includes the validated complete-cell correction (405282ec). The old 4c3bed8a spatial-direction execution declaration remains immutable and unstarted. Before any candidate MRI launch, prepare an explicitly revised executable/protocol that incorporates this correction in both baseline and candidate lanes and explains the historical-map comparison; do not silently substitute source in v1. D01/D02/P02 gates remain open and no candidate full fits have run. The corrected C04/root diagnosis does not establish acquired-MRI gain or close those gates.
